howToUse.title: How to prepare a vial
howToUse.intro: A quick reference for reconstituting a lyophilized peptide.
howToUse.step1: Remove the plastic cap from the peptide vial
howToUse.step2: Wipe the stoppers with an alcohol swab
howToUse.step3: Draw up the chosen amount of bacteriostatic water
howToUse.step4: Slowly inject down the inside wall of the peptide vial
